headline: KCP Sugar files Regulation 29(2) disclosure of substantial acquisition
sum: KCP Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited filed a Regulation 29(2) disclosure with NSE/BSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares. The specific identity of the acquirer, acquisition percentage, and consideration value are not disclosed in publicly accessible filings as of the filing date.
detail: KCP Sugar and Industries Corporation Limited, a publicly listed sugar and industrial company headquartered in Jalgaon, Maharashtra, made a formal disclosure under Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation requires disclosure when a person acquires shares crossing prescribed thresholds (typically 25%, 50%, or 75%). The filing was processed by NSE on June 19, 2026, but the substantive details of the acquisition (acquirer, quantity, price, conditions) remain in the sealed disclosure document.
